name: Wishlist
description: The products a shopper has saved, as a card grid with a remove control on each — their own browser's list, not the store's.

fields.name: Heading
fields.helpText: The page heading, with the saved count beside it. Empty uses "Your wishlist".

fields.name: Empty title
fields.helpText: Shown with a heart icon when nothing is saved.

fields.name: Empty text
fields.helpText: One or two sentences with the next step.

fields.name: Continue shopping
fields.helpText: Where the empty state's button goes. Seeded as the home page, the one destination every store has.
